quote: Answer Accuracy measures the percentage of correctly answered questions. Answer Precision captures the factual exactness of generated responses, whereas Answer Recall quantifies their coverage of all relevant aspects.

Performance is reported using five complementary indicators. Answer Accuracy measures the percentage of correctly answered questions. Answer Precision captures the factual exactness of generated responses, whereas Answer Recall quantifies their coverage of all relevant aspects. On the retrieval side, Retrieval Coverage denotes the proportion of gold evidence successfully retrieved, and Retrieval Precision@k evaluates the precision of the top‑k documents supplied to the generator.
